items.name: ExxonMobil
items.headline: Reports Q3 earnings of $15.4B and announces $20B of 2027 share repurchases
items.catalyst: Q3 earnings were $15.4 billion, or $3.72 per share; the board declared a $1.07 fourth-quarter dividend.
items.thesis: Cash flow from operating activities was $25.7 billion and free cash flow was $19.1 billion. The buyback figure assumes reasonable market conditions.

items.name: Chevron
items.headline: Reports Q3 EPS of $5.06 versus $1.82 a year earlier
items.catalyst: Q3 diluted EPS was $5.06 versus $1.82; total revenues and other income were $67,798 million versus $49,726 million.
items.thesis: Adjusted earnings were $10.4 billion, or $5.28 per share. The board declared a $1.78 quarterly dividend.
items.source_name: Chevron Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K Ex. 99.1)

items.name: Regeneron
items.headline: Reports Q3 revenue up 36% and non-GAAP EPS of $20.07 versus $11.83
items.catalyst: Q3 revenues were $5,116 million versus $3,754 million; GAAP diluted EPS was $18.45 versus $13.62.
items.thesis: Dupixent global net sales (recorded by Sanofi) rose 35% to $6.5 billion and EYLEA HD U.S. net sales rose 62% to $699 million.

items.name: Cboe Global Markets
items.headline: Reports Q3 diluted EPS of $4.08 and lifts organic net revenue growth target
items.catalyst: Q3 diluted EPS was $4.08 versus $2.85; net revenue was $712.2 million versus $605.5 million.
items.thesis: Cboe now expects 2026 organic total net revenue growth in the 'high teens' range, up from 'mid to high teens'.
items.source_name: Cboe Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K Ex. 99.1)

items.name: Colgate-Palmolive
items.headline: Reports Q3 net sales of $5,369M and diluted EPS of $0.94
items.catalyst: Q3 net sales were $5,369 million versus $5,131 million; GAAP diluted EPS was $0.94 versus $0.91.
items.thesis: Sales and per-share earnings both rose from a year earlier.

items.name: General Dynamics
items.headline: Reports Q3 operating earnings of $1.5B and $4.49 per diluted share
items.catalyst: Third-quarter 2026 operating earnings were $1.5 billion, or $4.49 per diluted share.
items.thesis: The company's release is dated Oct. 30, 2026; the figures here are those stated in its headline summary.
